summary: Iteration 14 - Comprehensive testing of new pricing (199/299/399 Kč) and registration features. All 18 backend tests passed. All frontend E2E tests passed. Key features verified: 1) Homepage pricing section shows 3 columns with correct prices (Zákazník 199, Dodavatel 299, Zákazník i dodavatel 399), 2) Pricing buttons link to /registrace?role=customer|supplier|customer_supplier, 3) Registration flow has 3 role options with prices, 4) IČO choice step (Mám IČO / Nemám IČO) works correctly, 5) 'Mám IČO' path shows OSVČ/Firma choice then IČO, DIČ, address, branches, 6) 'Nemám IČO' path shows name (required), addresses, phone, 7) Preferred languages multi-select (CZ, EN, DE) visible on details step, 8) ARES lookup button present, 9) Branch addresses input with add button, 10) customer_supplier role registration works with preferred_languages and branch_addresses fields, 11) Dashboard switcher links correctly hidden for regular customer/supplier users.
seed_data_creation: Multiple test registrations created with TEST_ prefix during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new pricing and registration features tested and working: 1) Homepage pricing section has 3 columns (199/299/399 Kč) with correct links to /registrace?role=customer|supplier|customer_supplier. 2) Registration flow: Step 1 (email+password) -> Step 2 (role selection with prices) -> Step 3 (IČO choice: Mám IČO/Nemám IČO) -> Step 4 (if Mám IČO: OSVČ/Firma choice) -> Step 5 (details with IČO/DIČ/address/branches OR name/addresses depending on IČO choice) -> Step 6 (categories for supplier/customer_supplier). 3) New fields: preferred_languages (multi-select CZ/EN/DE), branch_addresses (multiple with add button). 4) Backend accepts customer_supplier role with all new fields. 5) Dashboard switcher links (nav-switch-to-supplier, nav-switch-to-customer) are conditionally shown only for customer_supplier users. 6) Quick demand flow works from homepage. 7) Unread messages summary endpoint works for all roles including customer_supplier. Note: No customer_supplier user exists in test data yet - registration creates unverified users.
